product.description: Our Stage Right™ truss scrims will cover your truss set up and give it a professional look at weddings, trade shows, or mobile DJ gigs. Made out of Lycra®, these scrims will provide the perfect amount of stretch for a tight and refined look. Our truss scrims come in black or white, and sizes to match all of our segments of 8" boxed truss: 1M, 1.5M, and 2M.
